# f5xc_app_type (Data Source)

App Type object defines a application profile type from an advanced monitoring/security point of view.<br>An App type is a set of (micro) services that interact with one another and function as an application.<br>Services can be made members of a particular AppType set by adding label ves.io/app_type=app_type.metadata.name to services.<br>App type object is the profile for one such application label. One can define various advanced security features that can<br>be enabled for a given application in this object. All services in a given namespace that are labeled with<br>same ves.io/app_type label are assumed to be a single application. In a different namespace as two different<br>instances of same application.<br>app_type object is recommended per tenant and present only in shared namespace.<br>This way advanced security modeled developed for a given application can be shared across namespaces or deployments.<br>app_setting object can be used to enable a app_type monitoring profile in a given namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: App Type - Full

data "f5xc_app_type" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_app_type.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_app_type.example.namespace
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `business_logic_markup_setting` (Attributes) API Discovery Settings Setting specifying how API Discovery will be performed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--business_logic_markup_setting))
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `features` (Attributes List) Features List of various advanced security features enabled (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
